messages.subject: changing file to read in reactiveFileReader
parts:
I would like the file to be read by reactiveFileReader to depend on a global variable, x. But in my shiny, the reactiveFileReader keeps reading from the same file

in my server.R I have:

shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {

  fileData <-reactiveFileReader(1000,session,paste0('testfile','x'),readLines,encoding='utf-8')


 ...
 x <<- Sys.time()

contents1=fileData()

...


 x<<- Sys.time()

contents2=fileData()

})

Can the reactiveFileReader accomplish this? If not, what is an alternative way to continuously read from a file with a modifiable name?

Thank You!
